title: 5 Free AI Tools That Will Save You Hours Every Week
hook: These five free AI tools could give you your time back.

narration.text: These five free AI tools could give you your time back. Most people waste hours on tasks that AI can handle in seconds.
First up is ChatGPT's free tier. You can use it to draft emails, summarise long documents, or brainstorm ideas in moments.
Next is Notion AI, which has a free allowance built into Notion. It helps you take messy notes and turn them into clean, structured summaries.
Third is Google's NotebookLM. You upload your own documents and it answers questions about them, which is brilliant for research.
Fourth is Canva's free AI features. The magic write and background remover tools alone can cut your design time dramatically.
Fifth is Otter AI, which offers free meeting transcriptions. It listens to your calls and produces a written summary you can read in two minutes.
All five of these have genuinely useful free tiers, so you do not need to spend a penny to start saving time.
Try even one of them this week and see how much time you get back. Links to all five are in the description below.
